args.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT s1.CDSCode, s1.FundingType, s1.DOCType, s2.Enrollment (K-12), s3.Enrollment (Ages 5-17), s4.Enrollment (K-12) - s5.Enrollment (Ages 5-17)
FROM schools s1
JOIN satscores s2 ON s1.CDSCode = s2.cds
JOIN satscores s3 ON s1.CDSCode = s3.cds
JOIN satscores s4 ON s1.CDSCode = s4.cds
JOIN satscores s5 ON s1.CDSCode = s5.cds

  AND s4.Enrollment (K-12) > s5.Enrollment (Ages 5-17)
ORDER BY s4.Enrollment (K-12) - s5.Enrollment (Ages 5-17) DESC;
